description: Rotates the SSH Certificate Authority used to sign host certificates. Generates a new CA keypair, distributes the new public key alongside the old, verifies acceptance, then removes the old CA. Full rollback restores the previous TrustedUserCAKeys on all hosts.

ca_host_asset_id.label: CA Host Asset ID
ca_host_asset_id.description: Asset ID of the host that generates the new CA keypair. Defaults to the first target asset.

key_type.label: Key Type
key_type.description: SSH key type for the new CA keypair.

ca_key_path.label: CA Key Path
ca_key_path.description: Filesystem path (without extension) where the CA keypair is stored on the CA host.

trusted_user_ca_keys_path.label: TrustedUserCAKeys Path
trusted_user_ca_keys_path.description: Path to the TrustedUserCAKeys file on each target host (referenced in sshd_config).

rollback.description: Restore the previous TrustedUserCAKeys content on all hosts from snapshot and reload sshd.

steps.description: Verify agent connectivity on all target hosts; confirm ssh-keygen is available; read current TrustedUserCAKeys path from sshd_config
Read current TrustedUserCAKeys content from each host and store as pre-state for rollback
Generate new CA keypair on the designated CA host using ssh-keygen; record new public key and comment
Append new CA public key to TrustedUserCAKeys on all hosts; both old and new CA are now trusted simultaneously
Confirm new CA public key appears in TrustedUserCAKeys on each host before revoking the old CA
Remove old CA public key from TrustedUserCAKeys on all hosts and reload sshd
Summarize hosts updated, old CA removed, and new CA fingerprint
